messages:
Maya: did a quick keyboard + screen reader pass on the Filters bar in Console -> Project Insights. filing a few accessibility nits I found.

Alex: thanks, which page and how to repro?

Maya: Filters bar (top-left): tab into group, open the date dropdown, try arrow navigation between presets, and check icon buttons (clear, calendar). I used VoiceOver on mac and NVDA in a VM.

Jules: high level summary?

Maya: main issues:
- very weak focus indicator on filter pills (hard to spot when tabbing)
- some icon-only controls are divs with click handlers (not focusable)
- combobox lacks aria-expanded and aria-controls, and listbox items lack aria-selected
- placeholder text in inputs has low contrast (< 3:1)
- VoiceOver sometimes announces duplicate labels for the date control

Priya: do you have the exact color tokens? would be helpful to propose replacements.

Maya: current styles I inspected:
```
.filter-pill { background: #f6f7f9; color: #8a8f98; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 6px; }
.filter-pill:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: none; }
.icon-clear { display: inline-block; cursor: pointer; }
```

Maya: recommendations:
- increase text color contrast to meet 4.5:1 (suggested token: `--text-strong: #2f3338`) OR darken pill bg to hit ratio
- restore visible keyboard focus using existing `--focus-ring` token; example: `:focus { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring) }`
- convert icon interactive elements to <button aria-label="Clear date filter"> instead of divs
- combobox controller should have role="combobox" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="date-list" and the list should be role="listbox" with items role="option" aria-selected="false"
- ensure placeholder has higher contrast or move label outside the input; or use aria-label if visual placeholder is decorative
- add aria-live="polite" region for results count when filters update

Sam: voiceover duplicate readouts could be from both label+aria-labelledby pointing to same text. Maybe controller and visible label are both referenced.

Maya: yep. I saw the input had aria-label and also a visually-hidden label that was not referenced properly. Solution: keep either aria-label OR label+for, but avoid duplicating the same text in both references. Use aria-labelledby pointing to single label element if using external label.

Alex: for the focus ring, we prefer reusing the global token so it's consistent. Are we confident that token contrasts in dark mode too?

Jules: check both themes. If the token doesn't pass on both, we can apply a semi-transparent ring rgba(66,153,225,0.35) which usually works on light/dark.

Priya: I'll propose exact tokens in the PR: set pill text to `--text-strong` and pill bg to `--bg-muted`. Also add min-height: 44px for tappable area and white-space: normal to allow wrapping on narrow widths (prevents truncation for `Last 7 days`).

Maya: keyboard e2e tests to add after CSS+markup changes:
- Tab order through filter group and pills
- Activate dropdown with Enter/Space, navigate with Up/Down arrows, select with Enter, close with Esc
- Icon buttons focusable and operable with Space/Enter
- Live region announces updated results count

Sam: what about screen reader differences? anything NVDA-specific?

Maya: NVDA expects proper ARIA on active descendant patterns. We avoid aria-activedescendant unless necessary; instead set aria-selected on options. VoiceOver sometimes reads placeholder as selection if placeholder isn't aria-hidden. Best to hide decorative placeholders with aria-hidden="true" and keep a visible label.

Alex: I'll pick this up. Plan: update markup to use native buttons for icons, add aria attributes to combobox, swap color tokens, add focus style using `--focus-ring`. ETA: tomorrow EOD.

Priya: I'll add a short a11y checklist to the component doc: required ARIA, keyboard map, min tappable size, color contrast tokens.

Maya: please run `npx @axe-core/cli check` against the component before merging. a11y-bot: can we add a PR check?

a11y-bot: Suggestion recorded  Add `axe` CI job that runs on PRs touching components/**/*.css and components/**/*.tsx.

Alex: will include axe in the PR pipeline.

Sam: tiny copy nit: when filters clear, the toast says `Filters cleared`  maybe `Filters removed` reads better for screen readers? does wording matter for SRs?

Maya: wording can matter. Keep to simple verbs. For SRs, short is fine: `Filters cleared` is ok but ensure toast has role="status" aria-live="polite" so screen readers announce it.

Priya: noted. I'll update component docs and tests.

Alex: opening PR now, linking it here when ready.

Maya: thanks all 44d will re-run VoiceOver + NVDA on the PR and close out.

(End of thread)
